lastCompletedStory.title: Guard: checkBackstop never arms without a handoff on disk

nextStoryContext: checkBackstop (src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts) now takes a required handoffExistsFn on BackstopDeps/OrchRecycleWatchOptions, defaulting to existsSync(join(claudeDir, ORCH_HANDOFF_FILENAME)) from src/orchestrator/handoff.ts. It guards armMarkerFn: over-threshold occupancy alone is now a no-op unless the handoff file already exists on disk. Both checkBackstop and BackstopDeps are now exported for direct unit testing (test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts). This guard is a pure consumer-side check: US-001 does NOT add a producer of the handoff file on the backstop path, so today the backstop is a safe no-op mid-cycle until a handoff writer exists. Per the story notes, US-003 (the window-fix story) should land AFTER this guard so a corrected window never starts triggering teardown-with-data-loss. Also fixed one pre-existing integration test (test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts 'high-occupancy reader...') that previously asserted the marker arms on over-threshold occupancy alone; it now injects handoffExistsFn: () => true to preserve its original intent, and a new sibling test asserts the no-handoff no-op case.
